tasks.title: Prisma docflow schema, migration, totals trigger, invariant tests
tasks.acceptance: npm run test:integration
tasks.brief:
Model the DocFlow data layer in PostgreSQL schema `docflow` (see PLANS.md for the DDL; it is the source of truth).

prisma/schema.prisma: datasource postgresql with env("DATABASE_URL"); generator client; models Vendor, DocumentHeader (mapped to document_header, @@map and @@schema("docflow")), DocumentDetail (document_detail). Money fields must be Decimal. Add @@schema("docflow") to every model and list schemas = ["docflow"] in the datasource. If Prisma rejects that, report the exact error instead of silently dropping the schema.

Create the initial migration SQL by hand under prisma/migrations/<timestamp>_init/migration.sql so it also contains what Prisma cannot express:
- CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS docflow
- CHECK constraints: quantity > 0, price >= 0, amount = round(quantity*price, 2), status IN ('draft','submitted','approved','rejected')
- UNIQUE (shno, line_no), UNIQUE document_number
- FKs: document_detail.shno -> document_header(shno) ON DELETE CASCADE; document_header.vendor_id -> vendor(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
- a trigger function on document_detail (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) that recomputes document_header.total_amount and line_count for the affected shno and updates updated_at. Handle UPDATE of shno by recomputing both old and new headers.
- indexes on (vendor_id, document_date), status, and detail shno

Add lib/prisma.ts exporting a singleton PrismaClient (standard globalThis pattern for Next.js).

Add tests/integration/docflow-schema.test.ts (vitest) that connects to TEST_DATABASE_URL, resets the docflow schema (DROP SCHEMA docflow CASCADE then re-apply migrations via `prisma migrate deploy` run in a beforeAll child process, or by executing the migration SQL files in order), and asserts:
1. a detail row whose amount does not equal quantity*price is rejected
2. quantity = 0 is rejected
3. an invalid status is rejected
4. inserting two details updates header total_amount and line_count
5. deleting a detail recomputes totals
6. deleting a header cascades its details
7. deleting a vendor with documents is restricted

Add package.json scripts: test:integration (vitest run --dir tests/integration --no-file-parallelism), db:migrate (prisma migrate deploy). Tests must fail loudly if the database is unreachable rather than skipping.

Do not weaken any constraint to make a test pass.

tasks.title: Idempotent demonstration seed data
tasks.acceptance: npm run db:seed && npm run db:seed && npm run db:verify
tasks.brief:
Add an idempotent seed that can run twice with identical results (use upserts keyed on natural keys: vendor.code and document_header.document_number; details keyed by (shno, line_no)).

Seed 4 vendors and 6 documents spread across draft, submitted, approved and rejected, each with 1-4 line items whose amounts equal quantity*price. Do not include any currency symbol, currency code or locale money formatting: amounts are plain numbers.

Add package.json scripts: db:seed (runs the seed with plain node, no ts-node if avoidable), db:verify (node scripts/verify-seed.mjs).
scripts/verify-seed.mjs connects using DATABASE_URL and asserts: exactly 4 vendors and 6 documents exist, at least one document in each of the four statuses, every header total_amount equals the sum of its details, and document_number values are unique. Exit non-zero with a clear message on any mismatch.

Acceptance requires running the seed twice; the second run must not create duplicates.
